title: ShotSpec
description: Every shot of a piece, fully specified: lane, length, camera (ADR 0008), lighting, composition, text, subject and atmosphere, plus the transitions between shots. The lanes render from it; the shot hash is computed over each shot (ADR 0006).

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

id.description: Slug that names the shot spec, 2 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example "obsidian-bottle-shots".

briefId.description: Id of the brief the shots serve, for example "obsidian-bottle".

treatmentId.description: Id of the treatment the shots come from, for example "obsidian-bottle-t1".

lookId.description: Id of the look bible every shot uses, for example "obsidian".

width.description: Frame width in pixels of every shot, even, for example 1920.

height.description: Frame height in pixels of every shot, even, for example 1080.

shots.description: The shots in screen order; at least one for a piece that renders.

transitions.description: Transitions between consecutive shots; a pair of shots without an entry is joined by a cut. Each transition other than a cut shortens the piece by its frame count; a cut's frames are ignored.

createdAt.description: When the shot spec was written: an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-26T20:00:00.000Z.

Lane.description: Which lane renders a shot: html (HTML/CSS in a browser), three (Three.js WebGL in a browser) or blender.

FrameRate.description: Frames per second of every shot and of the delivery.

ShotSize.description: Shot size from extreme close-up (ECU) to extreme long shot (ELS).

CameraAngle.description: Camera height and tilt relative to the subject; dutch is a rolled horizon (see dutchDegrees).

CameraMove.description: Camera move preset baked by src/shared/camera/ into per-frame position, rotation, focal length and focus (ADR 0008).

EasingToken.description: Easing curve of a move or an animation, evaluated by src/shared/easing/ as a pure function of progress.

FocalLength.description: Lens focal length in millimetres on a 36 mm sensor (ADR 0008).

ShutterAngle.description: Shutter angle in degrees; 180 is the cinematic default, 360 doubles the motion blur, 90 halves it.

LightingPreset.description: Lighting setup from the lighting cookbook; every lane maps it to its own lights and calibrated intensities.

CompositionAnchor.description: Where the subject sits in the frame: the centre, a rule-of-thirds line or a golden-ratio line.

TextSide.description: Which side of the frame text occupies relative to the subject; none means the shot carries no text.

TextRole.description: The typographic role of a text element; the look bible's type scale sets its size and tracking.

TextAnimation.description: How a text element enters, as a pure function of the frame number.

Primitive.description: Procedural stand-in geometry for the subject when no asset is supplied; none means no stand-in.

TransitionType.description: The join between two shots or clips, mapped to ffmpeg xfade transitions (cut has no overlap).

Renderer.description: Whether the GPU (hardware) or a CPU rasterizer such as SwiftShader (software) produced the pixels.

Shot.description: One shot: everything a lane needs to render every frame of it as a pure function of the frame number.

id.description: Identifier of the shot, unique within the spec and used by the treatment, the job and the render manifest, for example "s01".

title.description: Short name of the shot, for example "Shoulder sweep".

durationFrames.description: Length of the shot in frames at the spec's fps, for example 120 for four seconds at 30 fps.

dutchDegrees.description: Horizon roll in degrees, -15 to 15, positive clockwise; 0 for a level horizon, for example 4 for a dutch angle.

exposureOffsetEv.description: Exposure offset in EV stops relative to the look bible's exposureEv, -2 to 2, for example -0.5.

text.description: Text elements overlaid on the shot, in reading order; empty when the shot carries no text.

narrationEvent.description: Id of the narration line that starts with this shot, for example "n1"; null when none.

seed.description: Seed of every seeded random choice in the shot (handheld jitter, motes), for example 7; the same seed reproduces the same frames.

renderProfile.description: How the still gate rendered the shot (ADR 0004): engine, backend and renderer; render refuses to switch. Null until the still gate sets it.

engine.description: Rendering engine, for example "chromium" for the browser lanes, "cycles" or "eevee" for Blender.

backend.description: Graphics backend the engine used: the ANGLE backend such as "d3d11" or "swiftshader-webgl" for browsers, the compute device such as "CUDA" or "CPU" for Blender.

RenderProfile.description: How a lane rendered a shot: the engine, its backend and whether a hardware or software renderer produced the pixels. The same shape as the render manifest's renderProfile.

engine.description: Rendering engine, for example "chromium" for the browser lanes, "cycles" or "eevee" for Blender.

backend.description: Graphics backend the engine used: the ANGLE backend such as "d3d11" or "swiftshader-webgl" for browsers, the compute device such as "CUDA" or "CPU" for Blender.

Lens.description: The physical lens of the shot on a 36 mm sensor (ADR 0008); every lane maps it to the same framing.

fStop.description: Aperture as an f-number, 1.4 to 22, for example 2.8; smaller is shallower focus.

focusDistanceM.description: Distance from the camera to the focus plane in metres, greater than 0, for example 1.2.

Move.description: The camera move of the shot, baked per frame by src/shared/camera/.

amplitude.description: Strength of the move from 0 (none) to 1 (the preset's full travel), for example 0.6.

startFrame.description: Frame of the shot at which the move starts, counted from 0 and below durationFrames, for example 0.

endFrame.description: Frame of the shot at which the move has finished (exclusive), above startFrame and at most durationFrames, for example 120; null means it finishes with the shot.

Lighting.description: The lighting of the shot: a cookbook preset with per-shot intensity and colour temperature adjustments.

keyIntensity.description: Key light intensity as a multiplier of the preset's own, 0 or more; 1 keeps the preset, for example 1.2.

fillRatio.description: Key-to-fill ratio, greater than 0; 4 means the key is four times the fill, for example 4.

rimIntensity.description: Rim light intensity as a multiplier of the preset's own, 0 or more; 0 removes the rim, for example 0.8.

kelvin.description: Colour temperature of the key light in kelvin, 1000 to 20000, for example 5600 for daylight.

Composition.description: Where the subject and the text sit in the frame; the composition solver places the camera from it.

headroomPct.description: Space above the subject as a percentage of the frame height, 0 to 30, for example 10.

leadRoomPct.description: Space in front of the subject in its facing or moving direction as a percentage of the frame width, 0 to 40, for example 15.

TextBox.description: The box a text element occupies, as fractions of the frame from its top-left corner; it must lie inside the title-safe area (the central 90 percent).

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the frame width, 0 to 1, for example 0.1.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the frame height, 0 to 1, for example 0.7.

w.description: Width as a fraction of the frame width, 0 to 1, for example 0.4.

h.description: Height as a fraction of the frame height, 0 to 1, for example 0.12.

TextElement.description: One piece of text overlaid on the shot, animated as a pure function of the frame number.

id.description: Identifier of the text element, unique within the shot, for example "t1".

content.description: The text shown, verbatim, for example "Now in 500 ml".

staggerMs.description: Delay between successive words or characters in milliseconds for staggered animations, 0 or more, for example 40.

inFrame.description: Frame of the shot at which the element starts entering, counted from 0 and below durationFrames, for example 12.

outFrame.description: Frame of the shot at which the element is gone (exclusive), above inFrame and at most durationFrames, for example 110; null means it stays until the shot ends.

BoundsM.description: The subject's bounding box in metres; the composition solver frames it.

w.description: Width in metres, greater than 0, for example 0.08.

h.description: Height in metres, greater than 0, for example 0.25.

d.description: Depth in metres, greater than 0, for example 0.08.

ShotSubject.description: What the shot shows: a ledger asset or a procedural primitive, with its size.

assetId.description: Id of the ledger asset that is the subject, present in assets.json under the data directory, for example "model:bottle"; null when the primitive stands in.

Atmosphere.description: Depth cues in the air of the shot.

haze.description: Haze density from 0 (clear) to 1 (thick), for example 0.15.

motes.description: Number of floating dust motes, 0 or more, placed from the shot's seed, for example 200.

Transition.description: A transition that starts at the end of one shot and overlaps the start of the next.

afterShotId.description: Id of the shot the transition follows; it must not be the last shot.

frames.description: Overlap length in frames, for example 15 for half a second at 30 fps; no longer than either neighbouring shot; ignored for a cut.
